audit.why: Even skill-matchup enchanter mirror; levels 1-3 favor Lulu (Pix auto + Glitterlance out-poke her short-range Q before it scales), levels 4-6 swing on cooldown trades, late game favors Lulu via single-target amp + polymorph.

Spikes: Lvl 2 (Lulu's poke edge before Seraphine's Q/passive echo scale), Lvl 6 (Seraphine's R Encore is a long chained charm - a real teamfight swing), 1st item (both enchanters spike, E-Beat Drop trades against shields), Late (Lulu's amp/poly/knockup edges the 2v2).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Beat Drop (Root, Seraphine's E) as matchup-defining but never states its cooldown, failing lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT. Seraphine's E is 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s.
audit.why: Point 6 (cooldown windows) requires the actual number so the advice is concrete and punishable.
audit.corrected: Beat Drop (E) is 11s at rank 1, down to 9s at rank 5 - once it's spent, Seraphine has no root and no slow to set up her duo, so that window is when Lulu's side commits.
